executive_summary: Maven test compilation failed with 100 errors across 3 test classes. Primary issues: (1) Type mismatches between Priority and TaskPriority enums, (2) Incorrect type conversions (long to UUID/String), (3) Service method signature mismatches requiring additional userId parameter, (4) Missing methods in GlobalExceptionHandler and InMemoryTaskDataStore classes.

errors.message: incompatible types: Priority cannot be converted to TaskPriority (repeated 13 times)
errors.root_cause: Test code uses Priority enum but the application expects TaskPriority enum. This indicates a mismatch between DTO definition and test expectations.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskCreateRequest and TaskUpdateRequest DTOs to use Priority enum instead of TaskPriority, or update all test cases to use TaskPriority enum consistently.

errors.message: incompatible types: long cannot be converted to UUID (repeated 10 times)
errors.root_cause: Test code uses long primitive for task IDs but the application now uses UUID type for task identifiers.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace all long task ID declarations with UUID.randomUUID() in test setup. Update TaskResponse constructor calls to use UUID instead of long.

errors.message: method createTask requires userId parameter (repeated 18 times across create/update/delete/get methods)
errors.root_cause: Service interface methods now require a userId (String) parameter but test mocks are calling methods without this parameter.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add userId parameter to all TaskService method calls in tests: createTask(userId, request), updateTask(taskId, userId, request), deleteTask(taskId, userId), getTaskById(taskId, userId), getUserTasks(userId, page, size, sortBy).

errors.message: cannot find symbol: method handleValidationErrors (repeated 2 times)
errors.root_cause: GlobalExceptionHandler no longer has handleValidationErrors method but tests are calling it.
errors.fix_recommendation: Remove or rename handleValidationErrors test methods to match the actual exception handler method name in GlobalExceptionHandler class.

errors.message: incompatible types: long to String, Priority to TaskPriority (repeated 12 times)
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore tests use incorrect types for userId (long instead of String) and priority (Priority instead of TaskPriority).
errors.fix_recommendation: Update InMemoryTaskDataStoreTest to use String for userId and TaskPriority enum. Change all userId from long to String format.

errors.message: method findByUserId requires sortBy parameter (repeated 4 times)
errors.root_cause: findByUserId method signature changed to require 4 parameters (userId, page, size, sortBy) but tests only pass 3.
errors.fix_recommendation: ) to all findByUserId calls in InMemoryTaskDataStoreTest.

errors.fix_recommendation: Remove test methods that call findAll() and existsById(), or implement these methods in InMemoryTaskDataStore if they are required.
